ruleDefinitions.name: ImagingDevices Unusual Parent/Child Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects unusual parent or children of the ImagingDevices.exe (Windows Contacts) process as seen being used with Bumblebee activity

sequences.query: (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WmiPrvSE\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\ImagingDevices\\\.exe$")) OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ImagingDevices\\\.exe$"))
